generate_gmock_from_header: generate Google Mock class stubs from a C++ header file for virtual methods
build_gmock_class_generator: build a Google Mock class generator that reads C++ source and outputs mock classes to stdout
test_gmock_class_generator: test the Google Mock class generator with a C++ header file containing virtual functions
refactor_gmock_class_generator: refactor the Google Mock class generator to support custom indentation via INDENT environment variable
summarize_gmock_class_generator: summarize the Google Mock class generator that parses C++ AST and emits MOCK_METHOD macros
